items.prompt: Generate Kamisato Ayaka CROUCHING SWORD BLOCK four full-body sequential poses, using reference ONLY for costume, adult anatomical proportions, exact silver ponytail and sword/scabbard identity. All face RIGHT, one fixed camera and anatomical scale, hand at upper abdomen, BOTH hands gripping same hilt; katana upright in front of chest between enemy on right and body. Deeply bend both knees and LOWER pelvis, rear foot braces, no kneeling flat, no lying down, no offensive lunge. Sequence lower from half crouch into low guard, stable low guard, receive impact with shoulders/hands recoiling LEFT slightly, recover low guard. Keep head and limb size identical; crouched frame shorter because knees fold, never shrink whole character. Same visible long silver blade and dark scabbard at left hip. Four SEPARATE figures in one horizontal row with large transparent gaps, complete feet and blade tip. Crisp flat-color illustration matching reference, genuinely transparent background with zero alpha outside characters, no gradients, particles, text, shadows, glow or other people.

Generate Kamisato Ayaka full-body fighter action sheet for ONE paired grapple combo: UPWARD LAUNCH followed by DOWNWARD SLAM, weapon SHEATHED at hip throughout, both hands free for grappling. Identity/costume/proportions reference only. All Ayaka face RIGHT fixed side-view camera same scale, no mirrored poses. No visible opponent in this sheet, no blood, injuries, particles, text or backgrounds. Preserve exact head/limb size in all poses and full costume/scabbard. The victim will be drawn as a separate synchronized animation. No extra limbs.

Generate Kamisato Ayaka BEING THROWN full-body six-pose sequence to match upward launch then downward slam by opponent on LEFT. Identity/outfit adult proportions and sheathed katana reference only, not reference defensive pose. Face LEFT consistently where visible; torso rotates naturally in flight without mirrored identity changes. Identical anatomical head and limb sizes; do NOT rescale each pose to same height. Genuinely transparent background, no floor shadow, no gradients, no particles, no text or other people. Keep all limbs anatomically readable and same costume.
